text: 【高盛：利率上升将率先冲击浮动利率借款人 杠杆融资信用改善或趋停】高盛表示，全球债券收益率上升及近期央行加息正给杠杆融资市场的浮动利率借款人带来更直接的压力，因为其融资成本会随基准利率迅速上升，而固定利率借款人主要在旧债到期再融资时才面临成本上升。该行预计，过去几个季度杠杆借款人信用指标的改善可能就此停滞，其中软件行业到期贷款再融资，以及房地产、汽车和家装等依赖融资驱动消费的领域压力更为明显。
text_en: [Goldman Sachs: Rising interest rates will hit floating-rate borrowers first; improvement in leveraged finance credit may stall] Goldman Sachs said that rising global bond yields and recent central bank rate hikes are putting more direct pressure on floating-rate borrowers in the leveraged finance market, because their financing costs rise quickly with benchmark rates, while fixed-rate borrowers mainly face higher costs when old debt matures and is refinanced. The bank expects that the improvement in leveraged borrowers' credit metrics over the past few quarters may stall here, with pressure more evident in refinancing of maturing loans in the software industry, as well as in finance-dependent consumer sectors such as real estate, autos and home improvement.
